title: Predictive model development: logistic regression and random forest
purpose: Builds two baseline classifiers, compares test performance, and exports predictions for later validation modules.
input: `Data` sheet with binary outcome and numeric predictors age, comorbidity index, lab value, and prior admissions.
outputs: Model comparison, ROC chart, test predictions, logistic coefficients, and random-forest importance.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
